title: GM Control, Simulation Depth & Advisory AI
objective: Deliver one bounded read-only ODL-08 projection for explicit visible GM-control references, simulation-depth profile references and MIB-15 advisory-AI proposal references over completed ODL-01..07 context, without implementing a GM-control engine, simulation engine, provider dispatch, AI-owned truth, autonomous commands, hidden-data disclosure or owner mutation.

resolved_contract.owner_rule: Every accepted ODL-08 record is explicit visible owner evidence carrying organization/subject identity, record kind, opaque canonical owner reference, owner authority/reference, profile/context, provenance and visibility references. ODL-08 does not infer GM control, simulation depth or AI advice from organization state, titles, counts, pressure, politics, roles, resources, crisis/recovery or SCL-facing inclusion.
resolved_contract.gm_control_rule: GM-control records are read-only references to WCI GM-workspace or APM automated-play controller authority. A record never grants GM role, system permission, action authority, autonomous command authority or direct owner-domain mutation.
resolved_contract.simulation_depth_rule: Simulation depth is represented only by explicit owner-authored profile/policy reference identity under profile/context. ODL-08 defines no universal shallow/medium/deep scale, numeric depth score, automatic fidelity escalation, background simulation engine or wall-clock advancement.
resolved_contract.advisory_ai_rule: Advisory-AI records are read-only references to MIB-15 provider-neutral proposal/candidate envelopes and authorized-context/provenance references. ODL-08 performs no provider dispatch, paid/live provider selection, model execution, prompt persistence, direct commit, GM adjudication, mechanical resolution, permission decision or irreversible advancement. AI-disabled/no-advisory input remains a complete valid path.
resolved_contract.resolution_rule: Visibility filtering occurs first. Records reconcile by canonical owner reference. A record resolves only when compatible visible observed evidence agrees on record kind, owner authority/reference and profile/context tuple. Missing or explicit-unknown remains unknown; incompatible-only or kind-owner mismatch remains incompatible; divergent visible kind/owner/profile/context tuples or mixed observed/incompatible evidence remains conflict. Canonical-owner contradictions are never auto-resolved.
resolved_contract.advisory_rule: Completed ODL-01..07 outputs may be surfaced only as separately labeled advisory context and never synthesize an ODL-08 record, alter simulation depth, authorize AI advice, issue commands, reveal hidden content or trigger owner-domain/SCL outcomes.
resolved_contract.project_time_rule: APW-D26 Project/time references may be carried as visible context only; wall-clock time, Project schedules, simulation profile references and AI advice never advance campaign time or mutate Projects.
resolved_contract.permission_rule: GM-control references, simulation profiles, advisory-AI proposals, organization titles or ODL states never imply system permission, action authority, command authority or consent.
resolved_contract.visibility_rule: Unauthorized organization, business, base, settlement, faction, crew, family, relationship, leadership, resource, Project, ODL, GM-control, simulation, AI, profile/context, provenance and permission evidence is filtered before records, states, counts, summaries, search, provenance, receipts, AI context or SCL-facing output; hidden cardinality remains undisclosed.
resolved_contract.mutation_rule: No owner-domain mutation, command execution, action adjudication, relationship/reputation/leadership/resource/Project/time mutation, system-permission grant, canonical write, SCL mechanics or AI-owned truth is performed.
resolved_contract.persistence: No durable ODL-08 persistence or duplicate GM-control/simulation/AI/owner/permission ledger; migration 0022 remains unreserved.
resolved_contract.validation: Acceptance first; genuine self-hosted RED while the production contract/panel are absent; exactly one ODL-08 current-family Validation Core profile with zero historical predecessor fanout; final exact-head self-hosted Linux/Windows plus deterministic comparison.
